material.description: USGS project page “Geophysical Mapping of Geologic Systems Host to Critical Mineral Deposits, Southern Midcontinent” (27 September 2024), sections “Science Issue and Relevance” and “Methods to Address Issue”: describes high-resolution airborne and regional ground geophysical methods for mapping concealed geology; the project collects, models and interprets airborne and ground data, supplements interpretation with drill-core examination where available, and combines airborne magnetic/radiometric surveys with airborne electromagnetics and ground magnetotellurics. This is a concrete USGS regional-project example supporting the possibility of combining remote measurements, ground observations and modelling to infer concealed subsurface structures. It is not a universal workflow; drill-core examination is conditional on availability, and the source does not establish every possible surface-observation method.
